summary_en: Yamaha Motor raised its full-year dividend forecast for the year ending December 2026 to 60 yen per share from 50 yen, with the interim dividend unchanged at 25 yen and the year-end dividend increased by 10 yen to 35 yen.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ended December 2026 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Yamaha Motor's board of directors approved a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. The company increased its full-year dividend per share to 60 yen from the previously announced forecast of 50 yen. The interim dividend remains unchanged at 25 yen per share, while the year-end dividend was raised by 10 yen to 35 yen per share.

The company stated that this increase reflects steady progress toward achieving its full-year consolidated financial forecast announced on August 4, 2026, combined with improved growth prospects and cash flow conditions. Yamaha Motor maintains a dividend policy targeting a total payout ratio of 40% or higher on a cumulative basis over its medium-term business plan period, while considering business performance outlooks and investment needs for future growth. The revision aims to enhance shareholder returns within this framework.
